text: What is PMDD premenstrual dysphoric disorder? Hailey Bieber discusses it, Oct. 2. PMDD, or premenstrual dysphoric disorder, is a severe form of premenstrual syndrome that brings intense mood symptoms in the days before a period starts. It is in the news because Hailey Bieber said she struggled with it after having her son.. Hailey Bieber discussed her PMDD experience in a Women's Wear Daily interview published Oct. 30, alongside Rhode's $5 million, three-year commitment to the Foundation for Women's Health.. PMDD is a condition that falls within the wider range of premenstrual symptoms. Per the Office on Women's Health within the Department of Health and Human Services, it typically appears in the final stretch before menstruation, usually within about two weeks of a period, and includes serious depression, irritability and tension. Compared with ordinary PMS, its symptoms are more intense. Hailey Bieber, founder of the beauty brand Rhode, told Women's Wear Daily in an interview published Oct. 30 that she struggled with PMDD after she had her son, Jack Blues, who was born in 2024. She described the lack of research and public conversation on the condition as frustrating. She also said that speaking publicly about it made her feel less alone. The subject came up as Rhode committed $5 million over three years to the Foundation for Women's Health, the brand's largest philanthropic investment to date. Of that amount, $1 million will create the Foundation for Women's Health Evergreen Fund, which will invest in companies developing women's health diagnostics and therapeutics. Grantees are expected to be announced in 2027.
